title: Excellent toaster.
text:
Excellent toaster.. I love the way this toaster toasts bread. It is even on both sides, you can raise it to check on it to be sure it's not too much or too little while it continues to stay on. It can do different thickness which is a plus. You can actually fit a sandwich into it. I have not tried with cheese but I think it would be ok as long as you don't have the cheese hanging off the bottom of the sandwich. I love that it does not "pop up". You just lift the basket to remove your item. No loud popup sound. It just has a soft beep to let you know the item is finished. This fits nicely agains a wall and is attractive, not an eyesore.

I made a ham and cheese sandwich with this toaster. It toasted fine but didn't heat the ham or cheese. I would suggest heating the meat prior to putting it on the bread. I put the cheese higher on the bread so it wouldn't melt into the toaster but it didn't melt at all. This would be great for a cold toasted sandwich!

product_metadata.title: Kenwood TTM610 Persona Collection Toaster with Adjustable Toasting Slot and Sandwich Basket, Silver
features: Patented adjustable toasting slot with wide, extra long toasting slot to accommodate a wide variety of breads, sandwiches and pastries
4 pre-set heating programs with dedicated settings for perfect toast, bagels, Panini and croissants
Sandwich cage gently cradles sandwiches and Panini for delicious results
Adjustable browning control and cancel function for precise personalization of the entire process
description: The Kenwood persona line is a collection of kitchen essentials for the ultimate personalized tea and toast experience. Your toaster is not just for breakfast anymore. Adjustable and accurate settings allow you to create personalized favorites. The patented adjustable single toasting slot offers a wide, extra long toasting slot that can accommodate a wide variety of breads, sandwiches and pastries to suit your toasting needs. Take the guesswork out of toasting with the decimated 4 pre-set heating settings, delivering perfect toast, bagels, Panini and croissants every time. The Peek & View function allows you to easily monitor the progress without canceling for precise browning. The included sandwich cage gently cradles sandwiches and Panini for delicious results. Additional features to complete the personalization of the entire browning and toasting process include adjustable browning control and cancel function, Sure grip touch points, manual high rise lever for easy removal of food, cancel button, left and right handed operation, push fit crumb tray and illuminated controls.
